name: feat-2893
title: Phase 4 of ADR-W-210 (#2893): a search that reaches its limit says so — 2-D, 3-D and analytic combined

cases.title: 2-D: on the kite, muting the first row starts a search that reaches its limit; it says so and offers «המשיכו לחפש»
lines: שטח משולש NCE = שטח משולש ACD
cases.lookFor: Type the eight lines (the last thinks for about 30 s), then untick row 1 («ABCD דלתון חסום במעגל»). After «חושב…» the row under the box reads «עדיין לא נמצא פתרון — החיפוש נעצר אחרי כ-10 שניות.» with «המשיכו לחפש».
cases.before: On prod the search behind that tick runs under the 12-second clock and answers as if it had finished (not measured here).

cases.title: 2-D: the #566 two-circle line draws its rescue with no question
cases.lookFor: The fifth line thinks for about 10 seconds and the figure redraws with the right angle at B and AB = BC; no «המשיכו לחפש».

cases.title: 2-D: a search that finishes and finds nothing keeps today's answer
cases.lookFor: Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת»: «אין תצורה אחרת — הצורה נקבעה (רק הגודל/המיקום משתנים)» beside the button, as today; no «המשיכו לחפש».

cases.title: 2-D: the defining interaction builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: The square, G on AD, the 37° angle at B; three green rows.

cases.title: complex: a conflicting line is refused naming the earlier line, as today
cases.lookFor: The second line is refused with today's sentence naming «z1 = 1 + i»; no «המשיכו לחפש».

cases.title: 3-D: a range no drawing reaches, on a pyramid — refused at once, word for word (the search tried its fixed count and finished)
cases.lookFor: «אין תצורה של הציור שבה הזווית נמצאת בתחום הזה, ולכן הנתון לא נוסף. בדקו את גבולות התחום.» at once; one row; no «המשיכו לחפש».
cases.before: unchanged (as on prod: refused in 0.42 s).
cases.expectRefusal: אין תצורה של הציור שבה הזווית נמצאת בתחום הזה

cases.title: 3-D: a range on a figure whose search is slow — after about 10 s the tool says it has not found one yet, and «המשיכו לחפש» searches on
cases.lookFor: Type the four lines. After the fourth, «חושב…» for about 10 seconds, then under the box: «עדיין לא נמצא פתרון — החיפוש נעצר אחרי כ-10 שניות.» with «המשיכו לחפש». The line stays in the box and is not added (three rows). Press «המשיכו לחפש»: about 10 seconds more, then the same sentence again, or the refusal «אין תצורה של הציור…» if the search finished its count in that round. Then type something else in the box: the sentence goes away.
cases.before: On prod the page freezes for nearly two minutes (measured 113.6 s), then refuses the line.
cases.notes: The operator played this mechanism on 2026-11-15 ("all tests pass"); closed on its assertions.

cases.title: 3-D: a range a drawing does reach is added at once, with no question
cases.lookFor: Two rows, the pyramid drawn; no sentence.

cases.title: 3-D: a wrong claim is still refused, word for word
cases.lookFor: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב»; one row; no «המשיכו לחפש».

cases.title: 3-D: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» on a figure with a range still redraws, with no question
cases.lookFor: Each press draws another pyramid; no sentence.

cases.title: 3-D: an ordinary figure and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» are untouched
cases.lookFor: The cube and M on BB′; the press redraws.

cases.title: Exam 2379: a tenth line searches about 10 s, says so, and goes on when asked
lines: מעגל N1 משיק למעגל M בנקודה A
מעגל N2 משיק למעגל M בנקודה A
הישר l משיק לשני מעגלים N1 ו- N2 בנקודות P ו- Q בהתאמה
הישר l חותך את ציר ה- y בנקודה הנמצאת מעל ציר ה- x
expect: עדיין לא נמצא פתרון — החיפוש נעצר אחרי כ-10 שניות.
cases.lookFor: On a cleared canvas, type the nine lines, then «P(1,1)». After about 10 s of «חושב…», under the box: «עדיין לא נמצא פתרון — החיפוש נעצר אחרי כ-10 שניות.» with a button «המשיכו לחפש»; «P(1,1)» is still in the box and no row was added. Press the button: «חושב…» again, and after about 7 s the refusal «לא נמצאה תצורה שבה מתקיים: «P(1,1)»» — today's refusal, word for word. (Pre-played in a browser on the merged tree: 10.1 s, then the refusal at 6.7 s; again 10.0 s and 6.9 s.)
cases.before: Prod shows «חושב…» for about 18 s with no other sign, then the refusal.
cases.notes: The operator played this mechanism on 2026-11-15 ("all tests pass"); closed on its assertions.

cases.title: A search that finishes and finds nothing keeps today's refusal
cases.lookFor: «לא נמצאה תצורה שבה מתקיים: «AB = 7»» at once; no «עדיין לא נמצא פתרון»; three rows.

cases.title: An ordinary figure is drawn as before
cases.lookFor: Three rows, the segment AB drawn, no question.

cases.title: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» changes the figure
cases.lookFor: The press moves C to another place.
